summary: Schmidhuber expects AI to make lives longer and healthier, stresses AI in the physical world and argues a ban on superintelligence is infeasible.

statements.quote: It’s infeasible to ban super intelligence. Compute continues to become 10 times cheaper every 5 years.
The future of intelligence is not just language; it is physical AI powered by World Models.
statements.venue: Sakana AI announcement of his role as Chief Scientific Advisor

statements.quote: Sure, as I have predicted for 5 decades, at some point we’ll have superhuman physical AI. But it will take longer than 2 years.
For many years, I have been predicting that our AI will continue to make people’s lives longer, healthier, easier, and happier.
On the other hand, curious systems are very difficult to predict, and it is difficult or impossible to prove that curiosity won’t kill the cat or others.
